scope: Document-authoring and review workflows linked by the W3C Guidebook and Writing Effective Explainers; not a claim to cover every W3C process.

skills.title: Explainers
skills.description: Draft or review a user-facing web feature explainer for early design discussion and TAG review.
skills.validation: ReSpec checks only when the source is ReSpec HTML; remaining guidance is not an automated validator.
